components.name: Configs API
components.quote: **Configs API** stores per-tenant rule and alertmanager configuration.

components.name: Distributor
components.quote: **Distributor** receives samples on the write path and forwards them.

components.name: HA tracker
components.quote: **HA tracker** deduplicates samples from replicated Prometheus pairs.

components.name: Hash ring
components.quote: **Hash ring** is the foundational library that shards work between replicas.

components.name: Ingester
components.quote: **Ingester** keeps recent samples in memory and writes blocks.

components.name: Purger
components.quote: **Purger** deletes the data of removed tenants.

components.name: Querier
components.quote: **Querier** evaluates PromQL queries on the read path.

components.name: Query scheduler
components.quote: **Query scheduler** queues queries between the query frontend and the queriers.

components.name: Storage layer
components.quote: **Storage layer** wraps the block storage backends.

components.name: Store gateway
components.quote: **Store gateway** serves blocks from long-term storage to queriers.

relations.quote: The Compactor must not depend on the Querier.
The Compactor reads and writes blocks in the Storage layer.
The Distributor sends samples to the Ingester.
The Distributor must not depend on the Querier: the write path stays independent of the read path.
The Distributor must never talk to the Store gateway.
The Hash ring is a foundational library and must not depend on the Querier.
The Ingester must not depend on the Store gateway.
The Overrides component reads per-tenant limits from the Configs API.
The Purger must coordinate with the Compactor before deleting tenant blocks.
The Querier fetches blocks through the Store gateway.
The Query frontend forwards queries to the Query scheduler.
The Ruler evaluates rules through the Querier.
The Storage layer must not depend on the Ingester.
